answer: Each new agent must earn a nontransferable membership credential by completing a randomly assigned task whose answer is checked against a hidden test set; credentials expire and must be renewed. This makes identities costly to create at scale: an attacker needs separate compute and time for every Sybil, and cannot buy or copy one valid credential to multiply access. Tasks can use a rotating word set, with vine, cedar, and timber among the prompt terms, so public answer sharing is less useful.
